mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TRAN_STATUS = '1' AND TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND TRAN_SENDDATE IS NULL AND TRAN_DATE <= SYSDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET TRAN_ETC5 = '${group_no}' WHERE TRAN_STATUS = '1' AND TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND TRAN_SENDDATE IS NULL AND TRAN_DATE <= SYSDATE AND ROWNUM <= 500
mapper.select: SELECT TRIM(TO_CHAR(TRAN_PR)) AS TRAN_PR, TRIM(CASE WHEN TRAN_TYPE = 1 THEN 'AT' WHEN TRAN_ETC3 IS NULL OR TRAN_ETC3 = '' THEN 'PH' ELSE TRAN_ETC3 END) AS TRAN_ETC3, TRAN_MSG AS TRAN_MSG, TRAN_MSG AS TRAN_MSG, TRIM(CASE WHEN TRAN_PHONE LIKE '82%' THEN TRAN_PHONE WHEN TRAN_PHONE LIKE '010%' THEN '82' || SUBSTR(TRAN_PHONE, 2) ELSE '82' || SUBSTR(TRAN_PHONE, 2) END) AS TRAN_PHONE, TRIM(TRAN_CALLBACK) AS TRAN_CALLBACK, TRAN_SUBJECT AS TRAN_SUBJECT, CASE WHEN LENGTH(TRAN_MSG) >= 90 THEN 'L' ELSE 'S' END AS smskind, TO_CHAR(TRAN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS TRAN_DATE, 'Y' AS RESEND, '2' AS p_invoice, TRAN_TMPL_CD AS TRAN_TMPL_CD, TRIM('${profile_key}') AS PROFILE_KEY, NVL(TO_CHAR(TRAN_SENDDATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), '00000000000000') AS TRAN_SENDDATE FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TRAN_ETC5 = '${group_no}' AND TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND TRAN_STATUS = '1'
mapper.update: UPDATE ${msg_table} SET TRAN_STATUS = '2', TRAN_SENDDATE = SYSDATE WHERE TRAN_ETC5 = '${group_no}' AND TRAN_TYPE = 1
UPDATE ${msg_table} SET TRAN_STATUS = '1', TRAN_SENDDATE = NULL, TRAN_ETC5 = NULL WHERE TRAN_ETC5 = '${group_no}' AND TRAN_TYPE IN (1)
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${log_table} SELECT * FROM ${msg_table} WHERE TRAN_PR = ${msgid}
